issues.detail: '[Librarian]' starts on its group's first lifeline (PlantUML usually draws it there); keep it short, or start the group at a participant further left
'[valid]' (alt/else/loop label) is crossed by 1 lifeline(s) past its own; these labels never wrap: shorten it to fit before the next lifeline, or reorder participants
